goals.description: Jaydee Canvot turned a Pascal Groß delivery from the left into his own net to give Brighton an early lead.
Diego Gómez caught Palace off guard with an audacious right-footed strike from around the halfway line into the high centre of the goal, the move started by Olivier Boscagli.
Yasin Ayari made it 3-0 inside 10 minutes with a right-footed finish from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner, set up by Charalambos Kostoulas.
Charalambos Kostoulas finished left-footed from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner after more work down the flank from Pascal Groß; the goal stood after a VAR check for handball.

goals.description: James Maddison, on his first competitive Spurs start since May 2025, curled a right-footed shot from outside the box into the top left corner after a pass from Mohammed Kudus.
Jack Rudoni powered his way into the Tottenham penalty area and forced the equaliser home from the left side of the six-yard box, set up by Brandon Thomas-Asante.

Omar Marmoush restored the lead with his first goal for the club, a right-footed strike from outside the box into the bottom right corner after Andy Robertson's pass. VAR quickly cleared a possible elbow on Milan van Ewijk in the build-up.
Substitute Ben Davies sealed Spurs' first league win of the season deep in stoppage time with a surprise strike from outside the box into the bottom left corner, assisted by Dominic Solanke.
